name: Hawkins — Hopper (Client Finder Review and Send)

nodes.name: Owner Configuration
nodes.notes: Dedicated Client Finder bot only. Set owner IDs and confirm the prefilled Hawkins Supabase URL; select verified Client Finder Telegram, Hawkins Supabase Custom Auth (apikey + Authorization headers), Gmail OAuth2, and internal service Bearer Auth credentials. Configure a user-owned independent n8n error workflow before activation. Keep inactive until live inbox and sender checks pass.

parameters.errorMessage: Client Finder owner IDs and Supabase URL must be configured.

nodes.name: Acknowledge Review Tap
nodes.notes: Acknowledging a Telegram button is informational. Review Action runs directly from the parsed owner callback and must not depend on this API call succeeding.

parameters.text: Telegram could not acknowledge a Client Finder button tap. The saved review action is being processed separately; check its result before tapping again.

nodes.name: Send Immutable Gmail Payload
nodes.notes: Initial and follow-up approvals both send the immutable attempt payload as a new email. Follow-ups use a new honest subject prepared and approved earlier; do not add Re: or reply headers. Each Gmail result receives its own message and thread IDs.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { attempt_id: $('Recheck and Begin Send').first().json.id, gmail_message_id: $json.id, gmail_thread_id: $json.threadId } }}

parameters.text: Client Finder rejected a review-button tap because the owner, chat, or card data did not match. No email was sent by that tap.

nodes.notes: This alert may fail with the original Telegram send. Configure an independent n8n error workflow or external alert channel before activation.

parameters.text: Client Finder could not confirm delivery of the revised review card. The old card is stale; check the dedicated bot conversation and stored draft.
